correctness.rationale: Threshold-wise order-statistic identity is exact; binary wall erosion proves exact first-periodic-entry time and only periods 1 or 2. Inclusion-exclusion on both threshold checkerboards gives 4*2^(n/2)-2. In the iid law each threshold contributes (5/9)(2/9)^s per maximal alternating start; local-dependence Chen–Stein with mixed overlap O(n*3^(-2s-1)) gives Poisson parameter (10/9)alpha, while one-threshold variance and upper union bound give E tau=log_(9/2)n+O(1). Complete brute force through 11 vertices, independent trace through 7 vertices, and seeded finite simulations were replayed from actual bundled checker.

value.rationale: A natural minimal ordered three-symbol smoothing system exhibits a nontrivial coupling-dependent joint Poisson extinction clock, exact oscillatory basin and expected first-periodic-entry scale. This quantitative distinction from binary majority and categorical plurality is mathematically motivated and useful for repeated median denoising stopping times.
